# Historical Scene execution audit

**Scope and provenance.** Citations below identify source IDs and exact lines. All expanded files are under `/srv/lab-disks/disk2/users/xymo/Documents/Codex/2026-11-02/scene-rsi-rsi-1-3d-blender/outputs/scene_rsi_pilot/results/r1/scene_rsi_pilot/C2/test/`; the relative paths below complete the original file names. Their archive provenance is `/srv/lab-disks/disk2/users/xymo/Documents/Codex/2026-11-02/scene-rsi-rsi-1-3d-blender/work/scene_archive/bundles/r1--scene_rsi_pilot.tar.gz`, with each member formed by prefixing the relative path with `experiments/scene_rsi_pilot/results/r1/scene_rsi_pilot/C2/test/`.

## Historic metalworking workshop — commons_155212263

**Construction and intent.** Step 2 describes a camera-only correction to a previously successful build; its reference and render anchor locations are explicitly visual hypotheses, not calibration (X0711, `commons_155212263/steps/002/build.py`, lines 5–21). Boxes and rods form semantic Assets and Parts: a 43-board floor, windows, continuous bench, separate lathes, segmented-rim wheels, flywheel machine, anvil and stump, drills, drawer, bins and tools (X0711, lines 47–86, 88–131, 133–227, 229–257). The bench top is coded at z=1.04; this is a model coordinate, not a measured physical connection. Ownership and coordinates do not establish contact, support or image fidelity (X0711, lines 31–33, 119–131, 196–213).

**Appearance and view.** After realization, the script asserts nonempty mesh descendants, copies mesh and material data, and adds noise-to-bump nodes to architecture and bench materials, with roughness 0.87; missing materials or Principled nodes are skipped (X0711, lines 333–370). The camera is at (4.35, −4.55, 3.15), aimed at (−0.55, 0.10, 0.70), lens 39 and sensor 36. Step 2 uses world strength 0.32 and area powers 1150/280 (X0711, lines 31–32, 372–383). Step 3 retains the camera and identifies a lighting-only hypothesis, reducing world strength to 0.10 and powers to 260/35; its stated expectation of darker silhouettes is not an observed quality result (X0713, `commons_155212263/steps/003/build.py`, lines 16–23, 41–54, 363–374).

**Execution and limits.** Steps 2 and 3 both report `ok: true`, null errors and empty stderr. Blender 4.2.10 logs completion at 16/16 samples, saving `final.png` and `scene.blend`, with render times 7.71 and 7.69 seconds respectively (X0712, `commons_155212263/steps/002/result.json`, lines 2–7; X0714, `commons_155212263/steps/003/result.json`, lines 2–7). The task records a 512×384 reference, not independently measured reconstruction geometry (X0715, `commons_155212263/task.json`, lines 2–5). No images are supplied here, so fidelity and improvement cannot be verified. A separate text-edit status says complete, exit 0, for a request to make the workbench hierarchy blue with roughness 0.45; it does not itself demonstrate the resulting material or preservation of other objects (X0716, `commons_155212263/text_edit/status.json`, lines 2–5). No selection or acceptance record for this scene is supplied.

## Electronics workbench — commons_16007442

**Construction and revisions.** The generated scene uses colored boxes, rods, swept tubes and a scaled ball under named editable Assets. It models the monitor, oscilloscope, cabinets, keyboard, meters, lamp, soldering equipment, aerosol can and loose leads; for example, the can has cylinder, top and two label parts (X0717, `commons_16007442/build.py`, lines 68–96, 107–156, 179–227, 256–283, 289–293, 325–342). The tabletop is coded at z=0.76; support and cable contacts remain approximations, not collision tests (X0717, lines 44–46, 53–56, 362–373). Materials are primitive colors, with no post-realize semantic material overrides in this build (X0717, lines 59–65, 371–374).

Step 1 used lens 43; step 2 changed to lens 54, lower aim and −7° roll while describing a camera-only revision (X0721, `commons_16007442/steps/001/build.py`, lines 25–28; X0723, `commons_16007442/steps/002/build.py`, lines 6–19, 35–40, 336–338). The final build states an illumination-only revision: ambient 0.10, main power 100/size 0.85 and fill 30/size 1.2 (X0717, lines 6–8, 53–58, 374–388). Its reported step-2 framing and pale appearance are visual estimates, not independent measurements (X0717, lines 9–23).

**Execution, selection and validation.** Step 1 actually reports a finished 16-sample render, saved image and blend file, null error and empty stderr (X0722, `commons_16007442/steps/001/result.json`, lines 2–7). The final build comments report valid images for steps 1 and 2, but their step-2 result and a step-3 render log are not supplied (X0717, lines 6–8). The record reports three executions, complete status, no runtime failure, and GPU-then-CPU device history; it does not explain the device change (X0718, `commons_16007442/record.json`, lines 16–16, 37–53, 65–103). `selected.json` records step 3, although the record’s `selected` field is null (X0719, `commons_16007442/selected.json`, lines 1–3; X0718, line 57).

The record marks validity and aerosol-can structural/material/composite operability as passing, but explicitly leaves semantic completeness and support/collision truth null. It reports overall 0.4499, SSIM 0.1550 and LPIPS 0.6458; these numbers are recorded metrics, not independently validated acceptance or visual quality (X0718, lines 17–34). Thus the supplied evidence distinguishes completed execution and operability from a potentially poor reconstruction; no image is available for visual judgment.
